activity_summary: You came back to Old Swan. You had not stepped onto the bank. The ring stayed a thing seen from the water. James has seen the oak and can be restless about a thing he has looked at. You did not repeat the seventeen on the stair.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Confirmed he had not stepped across.

entities.name: Davy Gannet
entities.context: Put you out where you got in.

entities.name: James Burbage
entities.context: Kept the oak as seen, and not his.

facets.activity: Got out at Old Swan, the ring still seen from the water

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I did not step onto it

quotes.speaker: davy_gannet
quotes.text: The other bank stays the other bank
